description: This file defines the DeleteMultipleObjectsException class used in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling exceptions during batch delete operations in Amazon S3.

classes.name: DeleteMultipleObjectsException
classes.description: An exception class that signals errors during batch delete operations on S3, containing information about deleted objects and errors encountered.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the exception with arrays of deleted objects and errors, setting a detailed message.

methods.name: createMessageFromErrors
methods.description: Generates a combined error message string from an array of error details.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of error details encountered during deletion.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Returns an array of successfully deleted object details.
